title: Eval Oasis: degradation action matrix and graceful failover PRD for Optimize
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD to define a tiered actionability matrix and automated graceful failover paths for Optimize evals. Goal: ensure we detect promptset regressions early, decide deterministic actions (alert, throttle, partial rollback, or full rollback), and minimize customer impact while preserving signal fidelity for post-mortem analysis.
spec_summary: Define prompt sampling cohorts, composite signal scoring, quantitative regression thresholds, A/B pass/fail criteria, and an ordered rollback/playbook matrix that supports micro-rollbacks, staged traffic reduction, and emergency blackouts. Include a deterministic decision tree for automated canary stops and a human-in-the-loop escalation path for ambiguous signals.
prompt_set_sampling:
- Cohorts: production top-10k queries, paid-customer subset, synthetic adversarial probes, and random stratified sample of long-tail queries.
- Sampling cadence: continuous streaming with daily stratified snapshot and on-deploy targeted snapshot of 5k examples.
- Sampling rule: weight by token volume and feature flags (privacy opt-outs excluded).
- Link to sample schema: https://confluence.redwood.ai/optimize/eval-oasis-sampling
thresholds:
- Composite regression score (CRS) computed from: accuracy-like signal (A), fluency/quality signal (Q), latency P95 (L), and hallucination sentinel rate (H). CRS = 0.5*A_drop + 0.25*Q_drop + 0.15*latency_increase_pct + 0.10*H_increase_pct.
- Tiered thresholds:
  - Advisory: CRS >= 5% but < 10% -> create incident ticket; no traffic change.
  - Canary stop: CRS >= 10% but < 20% OR any single signal breach (A_drop >= 8% OR H_increase_pct >= 5%) -> stop canary, preserve logs, revert canary traffic to baseline.
  - Staged rollback: CRS >= 20% OR 2+ signal types breached across 3 consecutive evaluation windows -> reduce traffic to model by 50% and trigger staged rollback plan.
  - Full rollback: CRS >= 40% OR customer-impacting regression flagged by support -> full rollback to previous model version and open postmortem.
- Special latency rule: P95 latency increase > 35% on production route triggers immediate degrade to lower-capacity model variant and alert SRE.
ab_test_criteria:
- Minimum power: cohorts combined must have at least 10k effective samples or 95% confidence interval computed with bootstrapping.
- A/B pass if: primary metric (quality-weighted acceptance) shows non-inferiority margin <= 2% and no individual cohort shows CRS >= 10%.
- Intermediate: if global non-inferiority holds but a high-value cohort (paid customers / top-500 intents) shows CRS 5-10%, trigger targeted traffic shift to baseline for that cohort and require manual PM sign-off.
- Statistical tests: use permutation test for non-parametric distributions and bayesian posterior checks for small sample cohorts.
rollback_playbook:
- Step 0 (pre-deploy): ensure golden prompt snapshot and deterministic seed, capture KV cache warmup traces, and register canary group identifiers.
- Step 1 (advisory alert): create triage ticket with reproducible examples, escalate to product/quality lead.
- Step 2 (canary stop): cut canary to 0%, keep canary logs and KV cache for 72h snapshot, notify customers on beta program if affected.
- Step 3 (staged rollback): run automated traffic siphon to baseline model (50% -> 25% -> 0% over 30 minutes), pin version on baseline and snapshot metrics every 5 minutes.
- Step 4 (full rollback): disable new rollout entirely, update routing rules, trigger incident bridge and initiate 72h postmortem.
- Human override: SRE or PM can trigger immediate full rollback; document reason and artifacts.
- Post-rollback: require root-cause PR with hypothesis, failing prompt samples, and acceptance plan for re-rollout.
rollout_steps:
- Canary config: 1% initial traffic for 1h, health checks every 5 minutes, then 5% for 2h if no advisory signals.
- Canary window: must evaluate at least 3 windows (1h, 2h, 24h) before reaching 25% traffic.
- Progressive ramp: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% with 24h stabilisation at each step for high-impact models.
- Auto-halt: any CRS spike above canary thresholds auto-halts and reverts to last stable percentage.
